_comment: Riverside launch pattern: test explicit player join before late arrival. Fees are charged only by Job_Activity.Launch. No additional payments, forced movement or invented companion outcomes. NPC scheduled work finds cinema seats in either screen after gathering in the lobby.

zh-cn.Mall_Cinema_Begin_initial: 大厅广播响起，提醒本场观众入场。检票口后是通往两个影厅的走廊，银幕前的灯光正渐渐暗下去。
zh-cn.Mall_Cinema_Begin_join: $joining.name$赶上了这一场放映。检票口旁的指示灯仍亮着，进影厅后便可以找座位看电影。
zh-cn.Mall_Cinema_Begin_late: $joining.name$到达时，电影已经开始。隔着影厅门能听见压低的对白声，入场时得放轻脚步。
